dimensions.name: Harm mechanism
dimensions.definition: The way the object's definitions say consumers lose assets or value, as a sociolinguistic signal of community discourse about consumer risk.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the single harm mechanism that the object's definitions name as the primary way consumers are harmed. If several apply, use this precedence: forced loss of pledged or leveraged assets, then manipulated execution, prices or data, then theft, fraud or misleading claims, then governance or treasury control loss, then locked, staked or penalized funds, then value loss from market movement or fees, and otherwise descriptive term or safeguard.

characteristics.name: Forced loss of pledged or leveraged assets
characteristics.definition: Consumers lose assets because pledged collateral is seized or liquidated when a position falls below its threshold, including cascades.

characteristics.name: Manipulated execution, prices or data
characteristics.definition: Consumers receive worse execution, prices or data because transactions, prices, volume or oracle inputs are manipulated or reordered.

characteristics.name: Theft, fraud or misleading claims
characteristics.definition: Consumers lose funds or access through fraud, scams, exploits, phishing, coercion or exaggerated claims.

characteristics.name: Governance or treasury control loss
characteristics.definition: Consumers are harmed by concentrated control, governance capture or draining of DAO-controlled funds.

characteristics.name: Locked, staked or penalized funds
characteristics.definition: Consumers cannot quickly access or lose part of funds that are locked, staked or subject to penalties such as slashing.

characteristics.name: Value loss from market movement or fees
characteristics.definition: Consumers lose value through price divergence, depegging, sell pressure, hype-driven buying, fees or holding through declines.

characteristics.name: Descriptive term or safeguard without harm mechanism
characteristics.definition: The term describes a technical concept, metric or protective mechanism whose definitions name no harm mechanism.

dimensions.name: Loss timing
dimensions.definition: Whether the consumer loss described by the object occurs as a sudden event, as a gradual or structural exposure, or is not time-bound.
dimensions.application_rule: Use sudden event-triggered loss when the object's definitions describe a discrete trigger event (an attack, a withdrawal, a breach, a sale or a shock). Use gradual or structural exposure when they describe a continuing position, lock, schedule, accumulation or ongoing condition. Use not time-bound term or safeguard when they describe a concept, metric, claim or protection with no loss timing.

characteristics.name: Sudden event-triggered loss
characteristics.definition: Consumer loss follows a discrete trigger event such as an exploit, liquidation, withdrawal, depeg or scam step.

characteristics.name: Gradual or structural exposure
characteristics.definition: Consumer exposure accumulates over time through a continuing position, lock, schedule, fee or market condition.

characteristics.name: Not time-bound term or safeguard
characteristics.definition: The term describes a concept, metric, claim or protection without a loss timing.

dimensions.name: Discourse register
dimensions.definition: The linguistic register in which the community uses the jargon or slang term, assigned by the first matching criterion of the application rule.
dimensions.application_rule: Apply in order and stop at the first match. (1) Slang or colloquial term when the definitions describe the term as informal, metaphorical or coined by the community, even if it also warns. (2) Otherwise warning or accusation of risk when the definitions say the community uses the term to warn about, accuse or name a misleading claim or consumer risk. (3) Otherwise technical description when the definitions describe a concept, mechanism or metric in technical documentation without informal, warning or accusatory framing.

characteristics.name: Slang or colloquial term
characteristics.definition: An informal, metaphorical or coined community term used to describe risks or harms.

characteristics.name: Warning or accusation of risk
characteristics.definition: A term used by the community to warn about or accuse others of a consumer risk or misleading claim.

characteristics.name: Technical description
characteristics.definition: A term used in technical documentation to describe a concept, mechanism or metric.

dimensions.name: Discourse channel
dimensions.definition: The channel in which the community discourse about the object takes place.
dimensions.application_rule: Apply the first criterion: use forum or social media discourse only when the definitions explicitly say that users, communities or forums discuss, warn about or originate the term. Otherwise use technical documentation, including terms defined or analysed in documentation even when they are also mentioned informally.

characteristics.name: Forum or social media discourse
characteristics.definition: The term is discussed, warned about or originated by DeFi users in forums or social media.

characteristics.name: Technical documentation
characteristics.definition: The term is used in technical documentation or analysis of DeFi mechanisms.

dimensions.name: Top-level DeFi risk category
dimensions.definition: The top-level risk category of DeFi risk that the object's definitions link the term to, as a technical concept that the community discourse signals about consumer risk.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the category whose risk source the object's definitions name as primary: smart contract risk for code logic errors or exploits in smart contracts; blockchain infrastructure risk for the underlying chain (forks, congestion, validation, energy); financial risk for market price changes or macroeconomic factors; operational risk for cyber security, admin keys, human factors or faulty procedures; societal risk for regulatory scrutiny, political change or societal views; social and people risk where the object concerns team or people-related weaknesses. If the definitions name no such source, choose the negation characteristic.

characteristics.name: Operational risk

characteristics.name: Financial risk
characteristics.definition: Risks associated with market price changes and macroeconomic factors affecting the operations or viability of a DeFi protocol, including market and macroeconomic risk.

characteristics.name: Social and people risk

characteristics.name: No top-level risk category
characteristics.definition: Stated absence: the object's definitions link the term to no top-level DeFi risk category, as a descriptive term or safeguard.
